changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment:
Whether a receipt took a material past the quantity its purchase order asked for, and whoever filed it said in the payload that the excess was real.
An over-receipt is now refused unless the payload acknowledges it, so a note carrying this flag is one somebody deliberately let through. It is stored on the document rather than worked out later because the order's received quantities go on moving with every further delivery: months on, the arithmetic no longer says which receipt was the one that exceeded the order, and nothing at all says the excess was deliberate.
Every receipt that already exists is false. That is accurate for them: nothing refused an over-receipt before this, so none of them was acknowledged.

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM status_transition WHERE entity_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER'

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO status_transition ( entity_type, entity_id, organization_id, from_status, to_status, source, occurred_at, note ) SELECT 'PURCHASE_ORDER', po.id, po.organization_id, NULL, po.status, 'BASELINE', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'The status this purchase order was observed to hold when its status trail began. What it was before that date, and who set it, was not recorded.' FROM purchase_order po WHERE po.status IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM status_transition WHERE entity_type = 'PURCHASE_ORDER' AND source = 'BASELINE';
